'''Blue 7''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Blue 7 was on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] and requested aid in transferring perishable material that was in danger of being discovered by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]].<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
